_comment: Starting lineup of each era, used to lay out the Drafts view and the Excel boards. 'from' is the first season it applies; a season uses the latest entry whose 'from' is not after it. Slots are filled from each team's players by price: fixed slots (QB RB WR TE K D/ST) take the priciest at that position (RB1 then RB2, ...); then the flex slots are filled in 'fill_order', each taking the priciest eligible player left ('prefer' lists positions tried first: SFLEX takes the 2nd QB if there is one). Everyone else sits on the bench (BE), priciest first. Add a new entry when the league changes its lineup. Slot names: QB RB WR TE K D/ST, FLEX (RB/WR), W/T (WR/TE), SFLEX (QB/RB/WR/TE).
